newton.note: Revised Definitions section (hd5); cross-ref numbers preserved as newton_def

methodology.lens: Common ancient Israelite knowledge of the natural world (pre-modern science). Figures must be supported by how the word is used within the allowed precedent books — not back-propagated from later genres (e.g. no NT readings applied to Genesis).

genre_rules.narrative: Historical narrative (Genesis–Kings, etc.): figures arise from simile, dream reports with in-text interpretation, covenant signs, and poetic speeches embedded in the story. Do not apply prophetic kingdom↔world systems unless the book itself uses them.
genre_rules.prophetic: Prophetic/apocalyptic: kingdom-world analogies (Newton Definitions) apply when genre and context support them; precedent may include earlier prophets and narrative background.
genre_rules.law: Legal texts: figurative language only where the legal discourse itself uses it (e.g. extended metaphor in parenesis), not imported prophetic codes.

scope_bible.note: Cross-biblical scoped senses by genre and book

sense_layers.note: Pan-biblical canon_senses and genre_senses layered above book scope

man_anatomy.note: Man body parts — Scripture-primary; Genesis precedent for narrative members

entries.label: Frame of heaven and earth
entries.sense: The kingdom compared to the whole frame of heaven and earth.
entries.note:
Newton's kingdom↔universe frame is prophetic in genre. Genesis uses heaven and earth as created realities (see scoped senses on those entries), not as a political allegory of a kingdom.
 Newton Def. 1 frames the whole prophetic system: kingdom compared to heaven and earth. Genesis scoped senses on sun, moon, star, heaven, earth treat created realities separately. Apply kingdom↔world only in prophe

entries.label: Moon
entries.sense: The next in dignity after the supreme magistrate.

entries.label: Star
entries.sense: Princes or inferior kings; later extended to common people (Def 28).

entries.label: Sun
entries.sense: The supreme magistrate; kingly power.

entries.label: Heaven
entries.sense: The court, honours, and dignities wherein luminaries and stars are placed.

entries.label: Earth
entries.sense: The condition of inferior people; sometimes one of two peoples distinguished from the sea.

entries.label: Sea
entries.sense: The condition of inferior people; sometimes one of two peoples distinguished from the earth.

entries.label: Waters
entries.sense: Peoples or aggregates of nations; sometimes riches or sound doctrine.

entries.label: Mountain
entries.sense: A city, especially the head city (Jerusalem, Babylon); sometimes a temple.
entries.note: Mountain is highly scope-sensitive: literal landform (dominant in Torah/history), sacred meeting-height (Sinai), prophetic city (Newton), temple-mount (Isa 2/Mic 4), obstacle or destroying power (Zech 4/Jer 51), and apocalyptic kingdom (Dan 2).

entries.label: Temple
entries.sense: A temple; idol-temple when context requires.

entries.label: Den
entries.sense: Buildings of cities, especially great stone buildings; hiding in dens = shutting idols in temples.

entries.label: Rock
entries.sense: Buildings or ruins of cities; falling rocks upon men = fall of idol-temples upon idols.

entries.label: Tree
entries.sense: Great and rich men of divers ranks according to the nature and bigness of the tree.

entries.label: Vegetables
entries.sense: Men (vegetables as a class).
entries.note: Category parent for tree/herb types. Genesis and narrative books use vegetation literally (see herb, tree, fruit scoped senses). Newton's "men as vegetables" applies in prophetic rank-systems only.

entries.label: Locust / insect swarm
entries.sense: Numerous armies.

entries.label: Wild beast
entries.sense: Armies; may grow into a kingdom still called a beast.

entries.label: Beast (societies)
entries.sense: Other societies or sects of men (e.g. frogs) according to their qualities.

entries.label: Wilderness
entries.sense: A country wasted by beasts, whether in temporal or spiritual matters.

entries.label: Flesh
entries.sense: Riches and money upon which beasts prey.

entries.label: Fowl of the air
entries.sense: Spirits, infectious diseases, troops of horsemen, or army commanders.

entries.label: Island
entries.sense: Cities or temples; courts of temples for building temples or altars.

entries.label: Ship
entries.sense: Buildings for commerce and profit — trading towns to nations, shops to tradesmen, temples to priests.

entries.label: Navy / war-ships
entries.sense: An army.

entries.label: River
entries.sense: Trains of armies running to and fro; or afflux of foreigners.

entries.label: Flood / overflowing waters
entries.sense: Invasions.

entries.label: Reed / flag
entries.sense: Men (of inferior or common sort in aquatic figures).

entries.label: Fountain
entries.sense: Cities and towns.

entries.label: Fish
entries.sense: Armies or people.

entries.label: Cloud
entries.sense: Great multitudes of people.

entries.label: Head (of beast)
entries.sense: Parts of the kingdom, collateral or successive.

entries.label: Horn (of beast)
entries.sense: Kings or subordinate kingdoms belonging to that head.

entries.label: Body (of beast)
entries.sense: The rest of the kingdom guarded and governed by the other parts.

entries.label: Fire
entries.sense: Consuming by war (men represented as combustible trees, ships, beasts).

entries.label: Earthquake
entries.sense: Wars and commotions.

entries.label: Wind
entries.sense: Long and continued series of war; whirlwinds = very violent destructive wars.

entries.label: Hail
entries.sense: Battles with loss to the side on which the tempest falls; aggravated if mixed with fire or blood.

entries.label: Rain
entries.sense: Refreshment of a kingdom by temporal or spiritual blessings; blessing of God.

entries.label: Horseman
entries.sense: A warrior or potentate.

entries.label: Bow
entries.sense: Victoriousness.
entries.note: Covenant bow in cloud is the separate entry rainbow_covenant (Genesis only). This entry tracks the war-bow and victoriousness similitude elsewhere.

entries.label: Altar
entries.sense: Martyrs.

entries.label: Woman (church)
entries.sense: The church.
entries.note: Most HB ishshah occurrences are literal women in narrative. Prophetic woman- similitudes are book-specific overlays below; do not import church=woman from NT.

entries.label: Whore
entries.sense: An adulterate church; idolatry of the church by whoredom.

entries.label: Idol / idols as men
entries.sense: Idols represented as men; hiding in dens = shutting idols in temples.

entries.label: Bottomless pit
entries.sense: Springing up of heresies or false religions.

entries.label: Winepress
entries.sense: Slaughter of the wicked (treading a winepress).

entries.label: Arm
entries.sense: The arm — upper limb and its strength; outstretched to redeem or to strike.

entries.label: Body
entries.sense: The body — flesh and frame of a man; carcass or mass when the text names the body of a beast in a vision.

entries.label: Branch
entries.sense: Part of a tree-figure; rank or subdivision within the tree-metaphor (extensible).
entries.note: Not explicitly numbered in Newton; structural slot for parts/metonyms.

entries.label: Cedar
entries.sense: Honourable and rich men.
entries.note: Cedar does not appear as a figure in Genesis; Newton sense applies only in prophetic scope.

entries.label: Eye
entries.sense: The eye — organ of sight; also the seeing of the heart, or eyes named on a figure in a vision.

entries.label: Face
entries.sense: The face (panim) — turned toward or away from another; presence, favor, or anger shown in the countenance.

entries.label: Foot
entries.sense: The foot — walks, stands, is washed, or tramples; also the low place beneath a throne when heaven and earth are named together.

entries.label: Forehead
entries.sense: The forehead — brow seen openly; marked in visions when allegiance or sparing is shown on the face.

entries.label: Fruit
entries.sense: Produce or outcome of a tree-figure (extensible for Genesis botany).

entries.label: Hand
entries.sense: The hand — grasps, works, strikes, blesses, or gives; what a man does with strength at the end of his arm.

entries.label: Head
entries.sense: The head — crown of the body; first in rank when the text names headship (rosh), whether on a man or on a figure in a vision.

entries.label: Heart
entries.sense: The heart (lev) — inward seat of thought, desire, courage, and turning; what the man purposes though none sees it.

entries.label: Heel
entries.sense: The heel — back of the foot; grasped at birth, wounded in enmity, or trodden underfoot.

entries.label: Herb / grass
entries.sense: Inferior people.

entries.label: Leaf
entries.sense: Used in similitude (stars falling as a leaf from a tree, Def 65); part-level detail within tree figures.

entries.label: Man
entries.sense: A man — a male person (ish), a mortal (enosh), or men as people where the sentence uses the word. The ordinary human figure any hearer knows from daily life.

entries.label: Mouth
entries.sense: The mouth — speech, command, and food pass through it; what speaks great things when the vision names a mouth.

entries.label: Oak
entries.sense: Men of strength and power.

entries.label: Shrub
entries.sense: Men of middle degree.

entries.label: Side
entries.sense: The side — flank of the body, or a quarter named from the body (tsela, yarek).

entries.label: Smoking furnace
entries.sense: Smoking oven and flaming torch passing between pieces — theophanic emblems in Abram's covenant-cutting (Gen 15), signifying God's binding oath in that rite.

entries.label: Vine
entries.sense: The rich and delicate; sometimes the wicked.
